scripts.dev: vp run build && wrangler dev --port 8790 -c apps/dashboard/wrangler.jsonc -c samples/state-counter/wrangler.jsonc -c samples/scheduler/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: vp run build && for c in samples/state-counter samples/scheduler apps/dashboard; do wrangler deploy -c $c/wrangler.jsonc || exit 1; done
